description.en:
Builds the bust-up portrait of a character (the picture shown next to its lines in dialogues), from the files in data/bustup/skin/, data/bustup/uniform/ and data/bustup/face/, and returns the portrait's handle. The ev_main helper CreateBustup places it on the left or right of the bottom screen.
The animal helpers pass true and the animal's number as third and fourth arguments; what these change was not traced further.
The character the portrait is for.
Passed on to the portrait builder (the animal helpers pass true).
Passed on to the portrait builder (the animal helpers pass the animal's number).

The portrait handle.
null if the portrait could not be built, the name is missing, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: For an animal (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_Animal; the Shift-JIS suffix is replaced by a variable here)
